turns.text: You need to buy some waterproof shoes.
I’m gonna buy… We are so cool.
Yeah, gonna buy some waterproof shoes in the January sales.
turns.zh: 对，打算趁一月份打折买双防水鞋。

turns.text: Do you want to buy some slippers as well?
turns.zh: 你要不要顺便买双拖鞋？

turns.text: I do have slippers in my calendar to maybe buy.
turns.zh: 我日历里还真记了，可能买双拖鞋。

turns.text: You've put in your calendar that you want to buy some slippers?
turns.zh: 你把想买拖鞋这事记在日历里了？

turns.text: Yeah because, okay no, because what would you do?
turns.zh: 对啊，因为……好吧不是，那不然你会怎么做？

turns.text: You would put it in a list, would you?
turns.zh: 你会把它列进清单里，对吧？
